sqlite_plans: PLAN SELECT v.hour,t.topic,COUNT(*) AS n FROM visits v JOIN visit_topics t ON v.token=t.token WHERE v.day BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY v.hour,t.topic ORDER BY n DESC,t.topic ASC,v.hour ASC LIMIT 48
STEP SEARCH v USING INDEX visit_day (day>? AND day<?)
STEP SEARCH t USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_visit_topics_1 (token=?)
STEP USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
STEP USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

PLAN SELECT v.type,a.feature,a.source,a.stage,COUNT(*) AS n FROM actions a JOIN visits v ON a.token=v.token WHERE a.day BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY v.type,a.feature,a.source,a.stage ORDER BY n DESC,a.feature ASC LIMIT 48
STEP SEARCH a USING INDEX action_day (day>? AND day<?)
STEP SEARCH v USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_visits_1 (token=?)
STEP USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
STEP USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

PLAN SELECT a.token,a.feature FROM visits v JOIN actions a ON a.token=v.token WHERE v.day BETWEEN ? AND ? AND a.source='manual' AND ((a.feature='save_media' AND a.stage='entry') OR (a.feature='copy_text' AND a.stage='success'))
STEP SEARCH v USING INDEX visit_day (day>? AND day<?)
STEP SEARCH a USING COVERING INDEX action_token (token=? AND source=?)
PLAN SELECT t.topic,t.token FROM visits v JOIN visit_topics t ON t.token=v.token WHERE v.day BETWEEN ? AND ? AND t.topic<>'' GROUP BY t.topic,t.token
STEP SEARCH v USING INDEX visit_day (day>? AND day<?)
STEP SEARCH t USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_visit_topics_1 (token=?)
STEP USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
